question.text: Mr. Arjun Kapoor is a certified Accredited Investor. What is the MINIMUM amount he must invest in a Cat II AIF scheme?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** SEBI has granted Accredited Investors (AIs) - and also employees/directors of the manager - a concessional minimum investment of INR 25 lakh (vs INR 1 crore for ordinary LPs). **The Trap:** INR 50 lakh is a fabricated mid-point. INR 1 crore is the ordinary LP floor. INR 2 crore is fabricated. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C tests the AI concessions extensively. XIX-A tests AI certification from distributor angle. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Always verify AI certification is valid at the date of subscription; stale certificates can void the concessional floor and trigger a refund/scheme-compliance issue.
